Flavor Profile: Clean, smooth, and espresso-forward, with a lighter body than straight espresso
Description: An Americano is made by diluting one or more shots of espresso with hot water. It keeps the aroma of espresso while creating a larger, milder black coffee drink.
Best For: People who like black coffee without milk and prefer a smoother taste than espresso

Main Ingredients: Espresso, steamed milk, and a thin layer of milk foam
Flavor Profile: Creamy, mild, and smooth, with a gentle espresso flavor
Description: A latte is an espresso-based drink with a larger amount of steamed milk and a small amount of foam. The milk softens the espresso, making it one of the most approachable milk coffee drinks.
Best For: People who enjoy a creamy coffee with a mild coffee taste

Main Ingredients: Espresso, steamed milk, and milk foam
Flavor Profile: Balanced, airy, and layered, with a stronger coffee presence than a latte
Description: A cappuccino is commonly prepared with a balanced combination of espresso, steamed milk, and foam. The thicker foam gives it a lighter texture and a more pronounced coffee flavor than a latte.
Best For: People who like both milk foam and a clear espresso taste

Main Ingredients: Espresso, chocolate, steamed milk, and optional whipped cream
Flavor Profile: Rich, sweet, and chocolatey, with a coffee base
Description: A mocha is similar to a latte but includes chocolate syrup or cocoa. It combines the bitterness of espresso with chocolate sweetness, making it feel close to a dessert-style coffee drink.
Best For: People who enjoy chocolate, sweet coffee, or dessert-like drinks

Main Ingredients: Finely ground coffee extracted with hot water under pressure
Flavor Profile: Strong, concentrated, bold, and aromatic, often with crema on top
Description: Espresso is a small, concentrated coffee shot made by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee under pressure. It is also the base for many popular cafe drinks.
Best For: People who want a strong coffee flavor in a small serving

Main Ingredients: Espresso and finely textured steamed milk microfoam
Flavor Profile: Velvety, smooth, and more espresso-forward than a latte
Description: A flat white is similar to a latte but is usually smaller and uses fine microfoam. It has a stronger coffee-to-milk balance, so the espresso flavor stands out more clearly.
Best For: People who want a smooth milk coffee with a stronger espresso taste

Main Ingredients: Espresso and a small amount of milk foam or milk
Flavor Profile: Bold and espresso-heavy, with a light touch of milk sweetness
Description: A macchiato is an espresso drink marked with a small amount of milk foam or milk. It keeps the espresso as the main flavor while adding a subtle milk note.
Best For: People who like espresso but want a small amount of milk softness

Main Ingredients: Coarsely ground coffee steeped in cold or room-temperature water
Flavor Profile: Smooth, mellow, less bitter, and often naturally sweet
Description: Cold brew is made by steeping coarsely ground coffee in cold or room-temperature water for an extended period. This brewing style usually produces a smoother and less bitter drink than regular iced coffee.
Best For: People who enjoy cold coffee with a smooth, low-bitterness taste
